declare
 cursor c1 is
 select unit_id, coll_date, component_prefix,
 components.product_code, expiry_date,system_label_decision,
 product_desc
 from components, valid_products
 where pooled_component_id = :ctrl_blk_2.pool_id
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id
 and SUBSTR(components.product_code,1,5) =
 valid_products.product_code 
-- and components.system_label_decision = abo_label
 -- and valid_abo_values.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme
-- AND valid_products.unit_scheme_type = :GLOBAL.code_scheme 
-- AND sysdate between valid_abo_values.eff_date and
 -- NVL(valid_abo_values.term_date,sysdate+365) 
 AND sysdate between valid_products.eff_date and
 nvl(valid_products.term_date,sysdate+365);
 cursor c2 is 
 select attrib_group, attrib_code
 from component_attributes
 where unit_id = :ctrl_blk_2.pool_id
 and product_code = :pooled_components.product_code
 and chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 code_scheme VARCHAR2(1);
v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;

begin
 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;

 end if;
 
 execute_trigger('validate_field');
 check_package_failure;
 if :ctrl_blk_2.pool_id is not null
 then
 go_block('pooled_components');
 clear_block(NO_VALIDATE);
 --execute_query(FOR_UPDATE,NO_WAIT);
 execute_query;
 
 go_block('attribs');
 for c2rec in c2
 loop
 :attribs.attrib_group := c2rec.attrib_group;
 :attribs.attrib_code := c2rec.attrib_code;
 down;
 end loop;

 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 for c1_rec in c1
 loop
 :ctrl_blk_1.unit_id := c1_rec.unit_id;
 :coll_date := c1_rec.coll_date;
 :component_prefix := c1_rec.component_prefix;
 :GLOBAL.pool := 'Y';

 then
 :ctrl_blk_2.code_scheme := 'I';
 else
 :ctrl_blk_2.code_scheme := 'C';
 end if; 
 If :ctrl_blk_2.code_scheme = 'C'
 then 
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id := 'D' ||c1_rec.unit_id || 'D';
 Else
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_unit_id := '=' ||c1_rec.unit_id || :ctrl_blk_2.chk_digit;
 End if; 
 :ctrl_blk_1.product_code := c1_rec.product_code;
 :ctrl_blk_1.expiry_date := c1_rec.expiry_date; --May need changes
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_product_code_desc := c1_rec.product_desc;
 select tested_abo_code, abo_short_name
 into :s_sld, :s_system_label_decision_desc
 from valid_abo_values
 where abo_label = c1_rec.system_label_decision
 and unit_scheme_type = :ctrl_blk_2.code_scheme
 and v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')); 

 down;
 end loop;
 
 :GLOBAL.first_entry_rec := :system.trigger_record;
 
 else
 :GLOBAL.first_entry_rec := '1';
 go_block('pooled_components');
 clear_block(no_validate);
 :GLOBAL.pool := 'N';
 end if;
end;

declare

BEGIN

IS
 temp_life_span_ind VARCHAR2(1);
 temp_exp_date date;

v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 -- Ashok comment: All time fields in this proc should be local; in date and out date;05/28/2011

 else

 end if;
 BEGIN
 SELECT decode(life_span_ind,'D', p_pool_date + life_span,
 'Y',add_months(nvl(p_pool_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')),
 life_span * 12),
 'H',nvl(p_pool_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))+(life_span / 24)),
 life_span_ind, life_span

--MESSAGE(temp_exp_date||','||temp_life_span_ind||','||temp_life_span||','||p_product_code);PAUSE;

 IF temp_life_span_ind != 'H'
 THEN

 to_date(to_char(temp_exp_date,'mmddyyyy')||'235959','mmddyyyyhh24miss') ;

 EXCEPTION
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then

 END;

 
BEGIN

 'Y',add_months(nvl(p_pool_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI')),

 life_span_ind
 into temp_exp_date1,temp_life_span_ind

 and attrib_group = 'SP'
 and attrib_code = 'POOL'
 and life_span is not null

 AND not exists
 (SELECT 'x' FROM valid_exp_date_ovr

 AND OVR_ATTRIB_CODE in 
 (SELECT attrib_code FROM component_attributes
 WHERE unit_id = :pooled_components.pool_id
 AND product_code = p_product_code
 AND chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id)
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date,to_date(to_char(v_sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'))
 );
 if temp_life_span_ind != 'H'
 then

 end if;
exception

end;


 IF temp_exp_date1 < temp_exp_date
THEN

 END IF;

ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
-- According to code 128 previous month units has to be carried to the next month in accordance 
--with a tolerance value specified at the chapter level.

--This procedure will validate Collection_year as per Code128 format 
PROCEDURE VALIDATE_COLLECTION_YEAR(p_collection_year in varchar2,
 p_coll_date in date)
IS

 temp_validate_yy number(3);
 temp_collection_year_add number(3);
 temp_collection_year_minus number(3);
 v_local_time date;
v_sysdate date;
BEGIN
 -- time zone change --5/11/11--sandip
 if Lifetrack_timezone_convert.Is_TIMEZONE_ENABLED then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),v_local_time);
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(v_local_time,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 else
 v_sysdate := to_date(to_char(sysdate,'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI'),'MM/DD/RR HH24:MI') ;
 end if;
 --collection year should be numeric 
 IF( LTRIM( p_collection_year,'0123456789') IS NOT NULL) THEN
 show_error('8020');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;

IF :SYSTEM.CURSOR_ITEM <> 'CTRL_BLK_2.SCAN_POOL_ID' THEN --TR 1196 - do not validate collection year for this field.

 --If the collection year and the system year are same then return back 
 IF ( TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy') ))THEN
 RETURN;
 END IF;
 -- check the label year should be (+,-) of 1 within the collection year.
 temp_collection_year_add :=TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) +1;
 temp_collection_year_minus := TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) -1;
 IF( temp_collection_year_add = 100 ) THEN
 temp_collection_year_add :=0;
 ELSIF ( temp_collection_year_minus = -1) THEN
 temp_collection_year_minus := 99;
 END IF;
 IF ((temp_collection_year_add = TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy'))) 
 OR ( temp_collection_year_minus=TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(sysdate,'yy'))) ) THEN 
 NULL;
 ELSE
 show_error('9708');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 -- Select the tolerance 
 DECLARE
 temp_v_global_chapter_id varchar2(5) := NAME_IN('global.chapter_id');
 temp_c_interval number(3);
 BEGIN
 SELECT validate_yy_value 
 INTO temp_validate_yy
 FROM chapters
 WHERE chapter_id =temp_v_global_chapter_id
 AND v_sysdate between eff_date and nvl(term_date, v_sysdate + 365) ;
 IF( temp_validate_yy = -1)
 OR ( temp_validate_yy IS NULL) THEN
 RETURN; -- No validation required
 END IF;
 IF ( TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) > TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR( SYSDATE,'yy') ) ) THEN 
 IF (( TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR( p_coll_date,'DDD')) ) > temp_validate_yy) THEN
 show_error('9709');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF;
 ELSIF (TO_NUMBER(p_collection_year) < TO_NUMBER(TO_CHAR(p_coll_date,'yy'))) THEN
 /*
 **calculate acceptable interval last day of the year of p_coll_date minus 
 **Julian day of the year for day of p_coll_date
 */
 temp_c_interval := TO_RRDATE(to_char(p_coll_date,'DD-MON-YY'),'DD-MON-RR') - TO_RRDATE( '31-DEC-'|| p_collection_year,'DD-MON-RR'); 
 IF( temp_c_interval > temp_validate_yy )THEN
 show_error('9709');
 check_package_failure;
 END IF; 
 END IF; 
 EXCEPTION
 WHEN NO_DATA_FOUND THEN
 NULL;-- dont validate
 /*WHEN form_trigger_failure THEN
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE;*/
 WHEN OTHERS THEN
 handle_error;
 END;

END IF;--IF NOT SCAN_POOL_ID

EXCEPTION
 when form_trigger_failure then
 raise FORM_TRIGGER_FAILURE; 
END;
